messages.content: Add tests for the main features

Commit all staged changes with exactly this commit message, unchanged:

Commit

Implement a complete REST endpoint for the described resource. Include:

1. Route, method(s), and idempotency where relevant
2. Request validation (body, query, path) with clear error responses
3. One success response shape (JSON) and status codes (200/201/204, 400, 404, 5xx)
4. Short doc comment or OpenAPI-style summary

Use the stack and conventions of the current project.

Build this project so I can see it in the preview: run its production build (for example npm run build) and make sure the built pages end up in dist, build or out. If it's a Next.js project, switch it to static export first (output: 'export'). Tell me when it's done.

I have started installing the dependencies with `npm install` and will proceed to build the production assets into `dist/` once it completes.
The production build is done.

The frontend bundle and server files have been compiled to [`dist/`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/TRUCKWITHEASE-1/blob/main/dist):
- **Entry HTML**: [`dist/index.html`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/TRUCKWITHEASE-1/blob/main/dist/index.html)
- **Static Assets**: [`dist/assets/`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/TRUCKWITHEASE-1/blob/main/dist/assets)
- **Server Bundle**: [`dist/server.cjs`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/TRUCKWITHEASE-1/blob/main/dist/server.cjs)

Update this legacy code to modern language and library features:

1. Replace deprecated APIs and old idioms with current best practices
2. Use modern syntax (e.g. pattern matching, async/await, collection APIs) where it clearly improves clarity or safety
3. Keep the same public behavior and avoid unnecessary structural changes
4. List the replacements in a short summary (e.g. “X → Y for Z”)

Provide the updated code and the summary.
Please commit all staged changes with a descriptive commit message

Build this project so I can see it in the preview: run its production build (for example npm run build) and make sure the built pages end up in dist, build or out. If it's a Next.js project, switch it to static export first (output: 'export'). Tell me when it's done.
